ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a six-membered conjugated ring, with two carbonyl groups on the ring, and R1 connected at the lower-left position; on the right side of the figure is a nitrogen-substituted alkene fragment, with H and R2 connected to the nitrogen, the nitrogen connected to an alkene carbon bearing CH3, and the other end of the double bond connected to a carbon bearing H and continuing to a carboxylate group CO2R3. The curved arrows in the figure indicate electron movement, but the problem asks to ignore the arrows. Reasoning: According to the specified method, on the left side start from the R1 connection position with a wildcard and write *C1, proceed along the six-membered conjugated quinone ring, and place =O at the two carbonyl positions shown, giving *C1=CC(=O)C=CC1=O. On the right side, write R2 as the wildcard on nitrogen as *N; the nitrogen is connected to the substituted alkene carbon bearing CH3, then along C=C to the carboxyl carbon, and R3 is represented by a wildcard on the ester oxygen, giving *N/C(C)=C/C(=O)O*. The two parts are not directly bonded in the figure, so connect them with a dot.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First transcribe the left visual fragment into a wildcard-substituted quinone SMILES by starting at the R1 attachment as `*C1`, following the conjugated six-membered ring, and placing the two ketone groups at the drawn carbonyl positions to obtain `*C1=CC(=O)C=CC1=O`. Then transcribe the right visual fragment separately: put wildcard R2 on nitrogen as `*N`, connect N to the substituted alkene carbon bearing CH3, continue across the drawn C=C to the carboxyl carbonyl, and put wildcard R3 on the ester oxygen, giving `*N/C(C)=C/C(=O)O*`. Join the two disconnected image fragments with a dot, yielding `*C1=CC(=O)C=CC1=O.*N/C(C)=C/C(=O)O*`.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个六元共轭环，环上有两个羰基，左下位置连有 R1；图中右侧是一个含氮取代的烯烃片段，氮上连有 H 和 R2，氮连接到一个带 CH3 的烯烃碳，双键另一端连接到带 H 的碳，并继续连接到羧酸酯基 CO2R3。图中的弯箭头表示电子移动，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：按指定方法，左侧从 R1 连接位用通配符开始写作 *C1，沿六元共轭醌环前进，并在图示两个羰基位置放置 =O，得到 *C1=CC(=O)C=CC1=O。右侧把 R2 作为氮上的通配符写作 *N，氮连到带 CH3 的取代烯烃碳，再沿 C=C 到羧基碳，R3 在酯氧上用通配符表示，得到 *N/C(C)=C/C(=O)O*。两部分在图中未直接成键，因此用点号连接。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the straightforward visual graph-to-SMILES route: it does not use reaction-arrow meaning, only transcribes the two disconnected drawn molecular skeletons and replaces R groups by wildcard atoms. For this open transcription task, it is the main genuinely distinct method.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as two disconnected structures with curved arrows to be ignored. On the left, identify a substituted 1,4-benzoquinone-like six-membered ring: two carbonyls on opposite ring positions and an R1 substituent on the lower-left ring carbon. On the right, identify an enamine/alkenoate fragment: NHR2 bonded to the left alkene carbon, that carbon also bears a methyl group, the other alkene carbon bears H and is bonded to a carbonyl ester group CO2R3.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text instruction only to know that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that the arrows in the drawing must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES conventions: encode unspecified R groups as wildcard atoms `*`; encode disconnected components with `.`; encode carbonyls as `C(=O)`; encode ester R3 as `O*`; preserve the drawn alkene geometry with slash notation where applicable. Ignore all curved arrows because the question asks for the transition-state structure only, not electron-flow annotation.
